## What

A one-line summary. Example: "Add a `bare` template that drops the hero diagram."
or "Document how to write a custom STT/TTS adapter for the voice service."

## Why

Why this helps the operator / recruiter / external user.

## What changed (or "what should change")

## Acceptance

What will the README or test suite look like after this change? Mention
`docs/`, `TEMPLATES.md`, or the matching vitest / pytest file.
